celebration.title: Nice work, family!
celebration.pandaProud: Privacy Panda is proud of your teamwork.

celebrationLines.po: “We must be as careful with our information as we are with our real bamboo treasures. You just proved it.”
celebrationLines.tao: “Slow, steady, and safe. The forest paths are stronger because of what you practised today.”
celebrationLines.ruby: “Kind choices travel far in the forest — and yours will echo for a long time.”
celebrationLines.mika: “You checked before you trusted. That is exactly how the Archive stays true.”
celebrationLines.billy: “Asking first is how the best things get built. Well done, builder.”
celebrationLines.lumi: “You chose what to share and how to share it. That light is yours.”
celebrationLines.fiona: “Your story online belongs to you. Today you decided how it gets told.”
celebrationLines.sage: “Knowing your rights is how fair agreements begin. The forest is wiser with you in it.”

progressExport.title: Progress Export & Import
progressExport.importIntro: Restore your progress from a previously exported file or clipboard data.
notes: Export your progress regularly to avoid losing your achievements
Importing will replace your current progress completely
Keep your progress files safe - they contain your learning history
Progress files are stored locally and never sent to external servers
progressExport.resetBody: This will permanently delete all your progress and achievements. Make sure to export your progress first!
